learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will meet the 26 happy letters of the English Alphabet family!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Did you know letters love to play together? Today, we are going to meet a big family of letters who make all the words in the world. Are you ready to say hello to them?

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The English Alphabet is a big happy family. There are 26 letters in this family. They always stand in a line starting from A and ending at Z.
Every letter has two cute shapes. One is a Big letter called Capital. The other is a Small letter. Big A and small a are best friends!
Letters are magical and they make words. Every letter has a special sound. Let us read some fun words together!

practice_quiz.question: ❓ How many letters are there in the English Alphabet?
❓ Which one is a Capital (Big) letter?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Alphabet Train Activity
fun_activity.instructions: Sing the ABC song out loud with your family. Clap your two little hands every time you say a new letter!

chapter_summary: ⭐ There are 26 letters in the English Alphabet.
⭐ Letters can be Big (Capital) or Small.
